host.name: native-pinch
host.completionClock: browser predicate observation + double-rAF opportunity; not physical scanout or completion of all later app work
host.feedbackScope: first visible feedback unmeasured; terminal readiness must not be relabelled as feedback
host.gapScope: post-marker interval may contain app work, later stalls and driver delivery; no pure-overhead attribution
host.frameScope: per-operation observations may extend past latency marker; session window required for continuous-stall claims

record.preHandlerOrdering: window capture; adapter must prove this precedes its app mutation path
record.scope: action-related retained cue plus double-rAF opportunity; no physical scanout claim
record.detectionScope: cancellable post-dispatch timer task, then frame probes; task scheduling delay included
record.collectionScope: outside host clock; validation and full record copies; host RPC separately measured

records.preHandlerOrdering: window capture; adapter must prove this precedes its app mutation path
records.scope: action-related retained cue plus double-rAF opportunity; no physical scanout claim
records.detectionScope: cancellable post-dispatch timer task, then frame probes; task scheduling delay included
records.collectionScope: outside host clock; validation and full record copies; host RPC separately measured

status.exportScope: export means drained to caller, not durable disk persistence

export.scope: outside-clock export to caller; caller must persist and retain its own failures

native.scope: filtered Event Timing dispatch; not meaningful pixels
native.cpuScope: sampled JS observer/receipt/export CPU only; quantized clock; not complete instrumentation overhead
native.unmatchedReceiptScope: missing entry is filtered/pending/ineligible/unknown, never zero latency

calibration.policy: nine native CDP Timestamp-minus-NavigationStart causal bounds; document-clock bracketing; additional1ms resolution allowance

summary.model: fixed offered rate; acknowledgements do not pace dispatch
summary.frameWitness: double-rAF opportunity with passive raw camera DTO, not physical scanout
